existing_test_defaults.environment: Pending separately recorded source/installed release gate.
existing_test_defaults.expected_result: Existing unittest assertions succeed with no skip/xfail/error/failure.
existing_test_defaults.invariant_oracle: Existing assertion body; identity is not a claim of independent oracle for every test.

families.contract: Exact integer/Decimal totals, asset separation and comparison A/B.
families.name: Financial accounting

families.contract: Economic and received-time cuts, report version, UTC normalization, immutable old results.
families.name: Temporal selection

families.contract: Full VOID and amount-only REPLACE, atomic competing/dependent groups.
families.name: Corrections

families.contract: Closed fields, duplicate/invalid data, roster and scope completeness; false certainty exclusions.
families.name: Manifest and data quality

families.contract: Local transactions, real process kills, acknowledgments, races, backups and SQLITE_BUSY.
families.name: Transaction and recovery

families.contract: Pinned Ed25519/DSSE scope, original acceptance epochs, policy and key relationships.
families.name: Signature and admission authority

families.contract: Complete captured input inventory, exact identities and raw bytes, external pin and complete semantic comparison.
families.name: Provenance, context and replay

families.contract: Independent finite generator/oracle, invariant controls, mutants and protocol counterexamples.
families.name: Properties and mutation sensitivity

families.contract: No overwrite/path alias, bounded inputs/outputs/deadline and controlled failure semantics.
families.name: Security and resource bounds

families.contract: Isolated sdist/wheel imports, profiles, dependency bounds and validation of verification scope.
families.name: Portability and packaging

finite_universe.claims: No exhaustive coverage of all combinations. Primary-family labels are navigation, not additive coverage percentages.

registration_stage: Before new research outcomes; does not revise protected release scope.
